A TRACEABLE PLANNING MODEL

From IFC to construction sequence.

This viewer uses the geometry and GUIDs of Abdo_Stair_II_Architectural.ifc, exported from Bonsai. Every represented element is linked to one activity. Amber shows installation in progress; completed elements use a neutral concrete, steel, stone and glass palette. Original IFC materials and GUIDs are retained. The AO control toggles contact shading.

Schedule assumptions

Editable baseline starts 19 October 2026. Work runs Monday–Saturday; curing allowances run every calendar day. Dependencies recalculate when a duration or start date changes. The concrete crew, steel crew, masonry and specialist crews may work in parallel. This is not a resource-loaded or cost-loaded programme.

Strength & stability

Curing durations are placeholders. Planned strength-review milestones do not grant approval to strip formwork, load concrete, erect steel or remove shores. Actual test results, engineered temporary works and the engineer’s releases govern execution.

Model scope

Three stair rises, supporting frame, architectural finishes, enclosure and indicative lift. Existing foundations and available formation are assumed. Excavation, complete foundations, unprovided railings and detailed connections are outside this model.

Provisional information

Supporting member sizes, some finish thicknesses, glazing, lift clearances and width transitions remain provisional. The simulation is a communication and sequencing tool; it does not assess structural forces, capacities or temporary stability.

Baseline 4D IFC ↓Model assumptions ↓

The downloadable 4D IFC contains the original baseline schedule. Browser edits are retained locally and exported through CSV or scenario JSON. Model completion is a count of elements, not earned progress, cost or labour.
